overview.Name: Gulfport Energy Corporation
overview.Description: Gulfport Energy Corporation engages in the acquisition, exploration, and production of natural gas, crude oil, and natural gas liquids in the United States. Its principal properties include Utica and Marcellus in eastern Ohio; and the SCOOP Woodford and Springer formations in central Oklahoma. Gulfport Energy Corporation was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma.
